summary: Iteration 57 — full FRONTEND regression sweep across homeowner, pro (Explorer-active), and admin flows. Pre-check confirmed pro@test.com is Explorer-active with all toolkits unlocked (seed.py fix from iter56 is holding). Every major surface loads without 500/404, all toolkits (Invoice, Tax, PM) are unlocked end-to-end, the Send-Quote modal explicitly shows 'no contact fee' for the Explorer pro, the Pro Dashboard renders Cash-Flow and Win-Rate-by-Category KPIs WITHOUT pro-locked overlays, /billing has no horizontal overflow at 375px, and the admin Toolkits tab renders plan_tier='explorer' rows without crashing. A handful of minor cosmetic/labelling issues and one minor SPA-fallback issue found — no critical regressions.

ui_bugs.issue: Banner inside quote modal says 'PRO  Pro plan — no contact fee' for an Explorer-tier pro. Logic is correct (no fee is charged) but the label should reflect the Explorer tier, not 'Pro plan', to avoid confusing Explorer users about which plan they are on.
ui_bugs.selector: Send Quote modal banner ('Pro plan — no contact fee')

ui_bugs.issue: For Explorer-active pro, the Current Plan card reads 'PRO  Pro Your Plan  Pro plan active.' The pro is on the Explorer 3-month intro plan, not the standard Pro plan. Should display 'Explorer plan active' (or similar) with the days-remaining hint.

Unknown SPA routes silently redirect to '/' (home) instead of showing a 404 page. Observed for /pro/dashboard, /pro/settings, /my-jobs (when navigated via direct goto before auth context warms up). Real routes are /dashboard, /settings, /dashboard (homeowner My Jobs). Add a catch-all 404 route for clarity.

integration_issues.issue: Filling the Project form (title, description, category=Painting, city=Vienna) and clicking the bottom submit button timed out — submit button did not become enabled / form did not submit within 30s. The TASK variant of the same form submitted successfully and redirected to /dashboard. Project form likely has additional required fields (e.g. budget or duration) without obvious validation feedback, leaving the submit button disabled silently. Add visible required-field hints / disabled-button tooltip on the Project form.

Could not exercise the accept-quote → status=in_progress → chat/booking flow because no test homeowner job currently has a pending quote on it (existing open jobs show 'Quotes (0)'). Recommend pre-seeding at least one homeowner job with a pending pro quote so this critical flow is testable on every iteration.

rca of the issue: N/A — no critical regressions. Two cosmetic mislabels stem from a single root cause: there is no central planLabel(plan_tier) helper, so several UI surfaces still hard-code the string 'Pro plan' to mean 'subscribed pro' instead of branching on plan_tier ∈ {standard, pro, explorer}. Recommendation: introduce one helper in a shared utils file and reuse it everywhere a plan name is rendered.
